The National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control has intercepted two cartons of suspected unauthorised pesticide packaging materials at the Mallam Aminu Kano International Airport, Kano. The agency disclosed this in a post on its official X page on Saturday. According to NAFDAC, officers of its Port Inspection Directorate made the interception on November 3, 2026, during routine examination and surveillance. The agency said, “The materials bore the label ‘Jubaili Final Force 30 g’ but had no evidence of NAFDAC registration.” It added that the consignment had been placed on hold with the Nigeria Customs Service pending further investigation. The agency stated, “The origin, ownership, intended use and regulatory status of the materials remain under investigation.” It explained that the interception formed part of its efforts to curb illegal imports. The post read, “Their interception is part of NAFDAC’s efforts to prevent the unauthorised importation and potential misuse of packaging materials that could facilitate the circulation of counterfeit and substandard products.” PUNCH Online reports that this development comes a day after NAFDAC said its Investigation and Enforcement officers uncovered expired baby diapers, methylated balms, unregistered baby wipes, disposable pants and other medical products in a store at Idumota, Lagos.
